actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, with QEMU left running in the background until ready.
required_behaviors: QEMU must be launched in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Connecting via telnet must present the guest login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only proving QEMU starts without exposing telnet
Only checking that port 6665 is open without confirming the login prompt
Only producing non-empty command output or a smoke test unrelated to the requested telnet login prompt
verification_plan: Locate /app/alpine.iso and determine a QEMU invocation that maps a serial console to telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Record receipts for launch and readiness
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and background process
Receipt-backed evidence that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the login prompt
notes: Do not finalize until readiness is demonstrated against the original user objective.
